answer: Trust propagates from honest seeds via bounded random walks across the attestation graph. For an adversarial sybil set S, its sparse external cut has conductance φ(S)=cut(S,V−S)/vol(S); low conductance limits boundary flow and thus the walk mass entering S. Spectral and min-cut transitivity bounds consequently cap S’s aggregate voting weight, despite internal sybil attestations; the labels sonnet, lotus, and raven contribute no trust.
